name: github
description: GitHub issues, pull requests, code, and Actions. Preferred CLI: `gh`. This MCP server is the fallback / structured interface when the CLI is not available.

alt_command.note: If you cannot run Docker, use the remote hosted GitHub MCP server (https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/) with OAuth, or the `gh` CLI directly.

notes: Never pass the token on the command line. Provide it via the GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable. Read-only by default; write actions (comment, PR) require confirmation.
